1949, July 18
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of brief messages on Seraphic Mass Association Cards by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
Mr. and Mrs. Harold Sherman
Please God, for speedy brightening of out look -- God's holy guidance
Emergency special membership
They should pray as best they can, forgetting about denomination. We are christian only in as far as we be- lieve in Jesus and Keep His word. With God the nam counts 0-
July 18, 1949 God bless all and each. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. Praised be Jesus!
(on reverse of. card is written under picture of Mary: ) Destined to be Mother of Jesus, Savior, and Help of Christians
The original in possession of: Mrs. Eldred Metty 20210 Regent Detroit, Mich. 48205
